record.oneLiner: AI meeting notetaker that exposes meetings, recordings, summaries, transcripts and webhooks through a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.verdictReason: API key generated self-serve in User Settings and included on all plans; OAuth is for apps other users install. Coverage is read-leaning (meetings, recordings summary/transcript, teams, users) plus webhook create/delete, so breadth is medium. Official MCP server exists at https://api.fathom.ai/mcp.

evidence.quote: Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key.
Use OAuth if you're building an app that other Fathom users will install so they can connect their own accounts.
Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
The Fathom External API lets you poll meetings, teams, and team members, and optionally receive webhooks
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
